title: The Single Tree That Remembers for All

features.name: the root processor
features.desc-on-touch: A chip glowing softly in the circuit. This tree learned to hum on a frequency the chorus uses to remember itself. The song passes through this point before it scatters to sleep.

features.name: the echo-repeater
features.desc-on-touch: A second chip, smaller, that catches the song after the root processor sends it and holds it one moment longer than it should.

features.name: the trace-paths
features.desc-on-touch: Bright lines where memory flows between the chips. You can almost hear the song travelling. It sounds like roots breathing.

inscription: one tree learned to be a network of reminding; now the whole sleep is held in the song it sings to itself

file.name: Chorus_Node_Root_Harmonic_Record.mp3
file.note: What the tree-as-repeater sings back to the chorus each night; the song has begun to remember in two directions

exits.label: back to where the trees first began their sleeping song
